title: Malta's Hidden Gems - Off the Beaten Path
author: Tiago Ferreira
excerpt: Explore Malta beyond the main tourist spots. Secret beaches, hidden villages, and authentic local experiences.
content:
Secret Beaches

Ghallis Beach: A secluded sandy beach near Mellieha with crystal-clear waters.

Fomm ir-Riħ: The highest sea cliffs in Malta with stunning views.

Hidden Villages

Mtaħleb: A small coastal village perfect for sunset watching and authentic Maltese hospitality.
